label: the and human nouns
explanation: This feature fires on every occurrence of "the" and, more strongly, on human-related nouns/pronouns such as people, they, who, children, school, and students, especially in narrative prose and at the start of sequences. It also fires weakly on many surrounding function words in such passages, but stays silent on abstract nouns, acronyms, abbreviations, parentheses, and technical vocabulary, where even "the" fires only weakly.
